readmeHtml:
sanyuan-skills

A collection of production-grade agent skills for Claude Code and other AI agent terminals.

Skills

Skill Description Install
Code Review Expert Senior engineer code review covering SOLID, security, performance, error handling npx skills add sanyuan0704/sanyuan-skills --path skills/code-review-expert
Sigma 1-on-1 AI tutor based on Bloom's 2-Sigma mastery learning with Socratic questioning npx skills add sanyuan0704/sanyuan-skills --path skills/sigma
Skill Review Quality audit for skills: structure, description, workflow, token efficiency, anti-patterns npx skills add sanyuan0704/sanyuan-skills --path skills/skill-review
Skill Forge Meta-skill for creating high-quality skills with 12 battle-tested techniques npx skills add sanyuan0704/sanyuan-skills --path skills/skill-forge
Wiki Ingest Compile articles, documents, or notes into a structured, cross-referenced wiki knowledge base npx skills add sanyuan0704/sanyuan-skills --path skills/wiki-ingest
Book Study Reading coach with knowledge compilation, Socratic mastery testing, spaced repetition, and cross-book querying npx skills add sanyuan0704/sanyuan-skills --path skills/book-study

Quick Start

Install any skill with:

npx skills add sanyuan0704/sanyuan-skills --path skills/<skill-name>

Then invoke in your agent terminal:

/code-review-expert    # Review current git changes
/sigma <topic>         # Start a tutoring session
/skill-review          # Audit an existing skill's quality
/skill-forge           # Create a new skill
/wiki-ingest           # Compile content into a wiki knowledge base
/book-study <book>     # Start a guided reading session

License

MIT

aiSummary.oneLiner: A curated collection of production-grade agent skills designed for Claude Code and similar AI terminals.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Sanyuan-skills is a repository that provides specialized tools or 'skills' that enhance CLI AI agents like Claude Code. It introduces domain-specific workflows ranging from a Code Review Expert to an AI tutor based on Socratic questioning. The toolkit focuses on elevating the quality of AI interactions by enforcing strict principles like SOLID, security, and performance boundary conditions during reviews. It also includes meta-skills for compiling knowledge bases and forging new high-quality agent abilities. This framework effectively transforms a generic AI terminal into a suite of specialized, senior-level expert personas.
keyFeatures: Code review expert: Conducts deep audits covering SOLID principles, security, and error handling.
Socratic tutor (Sigma): Implements Bloom's 2-Sigma mastery learning for interactive 1-on-1 tutoring.
Skill auditing mechanism: Reviews the structure, token efficiency, and workflow of other agent skills.
Knowledge base compiler: Ingests documents and notes into structured, cross-referenced wiki systems.
Meta-skill generation: Employs 12 battle-tested techniques to help users forge their own high-quality skills.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Targeted at developers using Claude Code or similar AI agent terminals who want to extend their agent's capabilities. Prerequisites include Node.js and an existing CLI AI setup.
